@name: Cleric
@slug: cleric
@source: character_law
@realms: Channeling
@prime_stats: In, Me
@description:
 Clerics are pure spell users of Channeling who have concentrated in spells
 that require direct power from their deities. These spell users are the most
 powerful of the spell users of Channeling, but they are also the most
 restricted because they should follow the tenants of their deity.
